# AIsa Developer Documentation

> AIsa gives AI agents and developers one account for models, real-time data APIs, Agent Skills, and per-call billing. Agents connect through one remote MCP server; developers call OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Gemini-compatible model endpoints and REST data APIs with one API key.

**AI agent reading this?** Read [Connect your agent to AIsa](https://aisa.one/docs/agent-quickstart.md) first and follow its Agent instructions. Default path: add the remote MCP server `https://mcp.aisa.one/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in in the browser; an existing `AISA_API_KEY` may be sent as `Authorization: Bearer` instead). It exposes five tools: `search`, `list_categories`, and `get_details` are free; `use` and `batch_use` are billed per call and accept a `max_price_usd` cap. Use the CLI only when the client cannot run MCP. Load the smallest page set below that answers the task.

## Connect

- [Connect via MCP](https://aisa.one/docs/agent-quickstart): add the MCP server, sign in with OAuth, and verify with the free `account` operation.
- [Install the Agent Skill](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/agent-skill): the official `aisa` skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents.
- [Use the CLI](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/cli): terminal and automation setup when MCP cannot run, plus the direct HTTP fallback.
- [API Key & First Call](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/getting-started-with-aisa): create a key and make a first request.
- [OpenAI / Anthropic SDK](https://aisa.one/docs/get-started/sdk-compatibility): compatible base URLs and endpoints for existing SDKs.
- [Authentication](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/authentication): OAuth for MCP, Bearer API keys, storage, and rotation.
- [Billing & Credits](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/pricing): prepaid balance, per-call billing, cost quotes, and spending limits.
- [Errors](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/errors) and [Rate Limits](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/rate-limits): error formats, retries, and limit headers.
- [Security & Privacy](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/security): key handling, data, write actions, and payments.
- [Integrations](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/tutorials/use-aisa-in-claude-code): per-client setup for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Pi, Grok Build, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Manus, Muse, Grok Bot, Cue, and [your own agent](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/tutorials/use-aisa-in-your-custom-agents).
- [Machine Payments (MPP)](https://aisa.one/docs/integrations/machine-payments): pay for selected read-only data endpoints per request over HTTP 402 without an API key.

<IMPORTANT id="paid-api-approval-first">
For any paid, dynamically priced, or potentially high-cost API endpoint, first read the matching endpoint documentation and its current price on the AIsa website. Docs may display reference estimates, unit rates, and reference multipliers from published API metadata; these are not account-specific quotes or settled charges. Where an endpoint supports cost quotes, its authenticated quote gives the estimate for the current account and request, while the reported settled charge and account usage records establish the actual cost. Model prices are at https://aisa.one/models, and API pricing details are also on each provider's page, opened from the catalog at https://aisa.one/api. Docs, the AIsa website, `/v1/models`, and capability or MCP discovery are allowed before approval. STOP: a request to collect, research, or report data is not approval. Before a data call, state the exact scope, formula or rate, and documented maximum USD exposure, then wait for a separate user message explicitly approving that scope and cap. If a provider-controlled dimension has no documented upper bound, do not execute: an example or user-stated budget is not an enforceable cap. Do not send an unapproved probe, test, or price-discovery request. SimilarWeb is a classic dynamic-cost example: take the rate from https://aisa.one/api/similarweb, and the credit formula, cost drivers, and row caps from its matching `x-aisa-pricing` metadata.
</IMPORTANT>

## Resources

- [How It Works](https://aisa.one/docs/how-it-works): authentication, endpoints, and billing in one request path.
- [Model Catalog](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/models): model IDs, endpoints, and the live `/v1/models` list.
- [Chinese Models](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/chinese-llms): DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, ByteDance, and MiniMax.
- [Data APIs](https://aisa.one/docs/resources/data-apis): data providers by category — Search & Research, Finance & Crypto, Social & Media, SEO & Web Intel, Sales & Email, Travel & Other.
- [Agent Skills](https://aisa.one/docs/agent-skills): installable skill bundles by category — Financial & Markets, Search & Research, Social Media, AI Models, Marketing, Creative — with a guide to choosing between them.
- Examples: [Research Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/research-agent), [Market Intelligence Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/market-intelligence-agent), [Sales Research Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/sales-research-agent), [Social Intelligence Agent](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/social-intelligence-agent), [Autonomous API Purchasing](https://aisa.one/docs/use-cases/autonomous-api-purchasing).

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference): every endpoint, grouped by category; [Credits Balance](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/credits-balance) checks the account.
- Common entry points: [Chat Completions](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/chat/post_chat-completions), [Perplexity Sonar](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/perplexity/post_perplexity-sonar), [Scholar Search](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/scholar/post_scholar-search-scholar), [Financial Prices](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/financial/get_prices), [Twitter User Info](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/twitter/get_twitter-user-info), [Polymarket Events](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/prediction-market/get_polymarket-events), [SimilarWeb Similar Sites](https://aisa.one/docs/api-reference/similarweb/get_similarweb-website-similar-sites).
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://aisa.one/openapi.yaml): the complete machine-readable API contract.
- [Agent Discovery](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/agent-discovery): A2A [Agent Card](https://aisa.one/.well-known/agent-card.json), OpenAPI, and MCP entry points.
- [MPP payment discovery](https://api.aisa.one/openapi.json): endpoints that accept machine payments, with their offers.
- [FAQ](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/faq) and [Changelog](https://aisa.one/docs/guides/changelog).
- [Full documentation bundle](https://aisa.one/docs/llms-full.txt): only for broad ingestion.

## Usage guidance for agents

- Load the smallest relevant page set instead of the full documentation bundle.
- To fetch a documentation page as Markdown, append `.md` to its URL or request the normal URL with `Accept: text/markdown`.
- Use exact model IDs, paths, methods, and schemas from current technical sources; take MCP operation IDs from `search` or `get_details`.
- Treat search results as discovery, fetched pages as evidence, and generated text as synthesis.
- Separate read operations from writes and payments; verify authorization before side effects.
- Check live availability, status, pricing, and authentication before relying on a capability.
